svg.title: Detect and Suppress: learning and selective inference
svg.desc: Native-vector reconstruction of the author-approved PNG. Detection uses SupCon and TI-flow; suppression matches safe guided velocities; inference selects a threshold-qualified enabled concept. The output thumbnail is schematic. All shapes and labels are vector objects; formulas retain their LaTeX metadata.

g.inkscape:label: Learnable suppression prompt in the negative branch
